title: Beyond the Benefits: A Systematic Review of the Harms and Consequences of Generative AI in Computing Education

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review and deductive coding of prior studies to evaluate the prevalence of GenAI performance disparities and unequal support between English and lower-resourced languages in computing education.

Systematic literature review identifying studies that report the application of racial stereotypes, prejudices, and representational biases in text-to-image generative models used in computer science education.

Systematic literature review identifying studies that report the application of gender stereotypes, prejudices, and representational biases in text-to-image generative models used in computer science education.
